text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer multi-paragraph development with separate sections for parents, teacher, and leaders","quality":"organization","description":"This captures clearer structural control through grouping ideas into distinct paragraphs and developing them in a more orderly way."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"The parents they are the best example\" and \"The teacher after the father they are so important\"","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures more extended explanation and elaboration of points rather than brief, undeveloped statements."},{"evidence":"comparative transitions such as \"Because,\" \"Example:\", \"and with this attitude\"","quality":"transitional control","description":"This captures somewhat stronger use of linking words to connect reasons, examples, and conclusions across the essay."},{"evidence":"more sustained attempt to explain cause and effect, like \"if her father is a drunk, and smoker what is a example him given to his sons\"","quality":"explanatory detail","description":"This captures a greater effort to support claims with examples and consequences instead of only making general assertions."},{"evidence":"mostly intelligible sentence chains across paragraphs despite frequent errors","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures better overall flow of ideas from one point to the next, even though the grammar is still weak."}]}
